sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting' AND (
    SELECT COUNT(link_to_member)
    FROM attendance
    WHERE link_to_event = e.event_id
) > 10
